plan.goal: Determine the number of biological replicates per group needed to detect a 1.0-sigma difference between two groups with 90% power at alpha 0.05 (two-sided t-test).
plan.rationale: Sample size computed from a two-sample two-sided t-test power analysis: effect size 1.0 (in units of pooled SD), std dev 1.0, alpha 0.05, power 0.90. This yields 22 replicates per group.
caveats: 22 is the biological replicate count per group; technical replicates do not substitute for biological replicates.
Assumes a two-sided two-sample t-test and equal variance; adjust if the design is paired, one-sided, or uses a different test.
Effect size is expressed in units of the pooled standard deviation (1.0-sigma); confirm the actual measurement units and expected SD in the lab.

provenance.formula: n from two-sample t-test power equation
